title: Taxonomic-name-resolution validator against pinned authoritative backbone
context: Taxonomic name drift is a primary source of citizen-science data error. This validator resolves taxon names against a pinned, versioned authoritative backbone so the check is reproducible, and it records the backbone version in the run manifest. To respect the non-destructive invariant it never silently rewrites a name. Depends on csp-validate-005.
objective: Implement a taxonomic-name-resolution validator that resolves names against a pinned authoritative backbone (e.g. GBIF backbone / Catalogue of Life), flags unmatched/ambiguous/synonym names with severities, and records the backbone version for reproducibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Resolves taxon names against a pinned, versioned authoritative backbone (e.g. GBIF backbone / Catalogue of Life); the version is recorded in the run manifest for reproducibility
Flags unmatched/ambiguous/synonym names as warn/error with the matched concept
Never silently rewrites a name without recording it in the change-ledger
Domain-reviewer-approved fixtures pass in CI on synthetic data
output: A PR adding the taxonomic-name-resolution validator with pinned-backbone version recording and severity-flagged outputs.
